absent: Layout and valid values of compact control and migration target control beyond the fields touched here.
Implementation and locking of isolation range handling and draining and hugepage replacement and freepage extraction and contiguous freeing.
Locking and calling context for the clean page reclamation helper and its shrinker interaction.
Numeric values of generic watermark levels and request flag bits referenced only by symbolic names.
Guarantees of large buddy outer alignment discovery and of isolation verification and tracing.
Reference counting and compound preparation effects and memory ordering for frozen versus refcounted results.
Full page extension record layout and per feature operation behavior beyond table membership.
Scheduling and signal handling consequences of interruption during migration and of retry limits.

findings.text: Public helper that scans a supplied folio collection, relocates clean file backed candidates to a private pile, asks the shrinker to discard them under a no reclaim guard, splices survivors back, adjusts isolated counters for reclaimed and lazyfree outcomes, and reports how many were freed.

Public reservation routine that takes frame number bounds plus allocation attributes and request flags, validates compound size limits and flag combinations, isolates the interval, drains per cpu caches, moves occupants away, handles huge pages, extracts the now free interval from the buddy system, and either leaves frozen single frames or prepares one compound head, always releasing isolation and returning success or a negative reason.
Public wrapper for exact intervals that rejects compound requests, delegates to the frozen variant, and on success marks every frame in the interval as referenced before returning the status.

Public search routine that given a length and request flags and preferred node and node mask walks the zonelist for an aligned candidate fully inside one zone, validates movability with an initial fast pass that skips huge pages and an optional second pass that considers them, attempts reservation for each candidate, and returns the first successful head or null when none succeeds.
Public wrapper for counted contiguous allocation that rejects compound requests, delegates to the frozen search, and on success marks the whole extent referenced before returning it.
Public release routine for a frame number base and length that warns and aborts when the base is a compound head and otherwise hands the extent to the internal contiguous free path.

Public helper that locates the buddy block containing a supplied page, removes it from the free lists, splits it down around the target, flags the target as taken for hardware poisoning, and reports whether extraction succeeded.

Public helper that attempts to return a previously extracted poisoned page to the buddy system when its reference count drops to zero, clearing taken off state and reporting whether poison state was cleared.
Public predicate that iterates online nodes and reports whether any node hosts a managed zone of the requested type.
Public predicate that probes successive alignments containing a page for buddy membership with sufficient order and reports true when such a container exists within the maximum order.

Public non locking allocation helpers that default an unspecified node to the current node and request frozen pages without sleeping on zone locks, with a further wrapper that marks the result referenced on success, plus an inline default flags frozen helper pinned to the current node.

Migration of an interval proceeds with caches disabled, repeatedly isolating occupants when the pending queue is empty and otherwise retrying migration with reclamation of clean pages first. Interruption aborts, repeated busy pending queues fail, memory exhaustion stops without further retry, cache state is restored, and failures restore movable pages while busy failures may emit diagnostics unless warnings are suppressed.

Only file backed and non dirty and evictable and non huge folios without movable operations are considered for discard after clearing active state. All other entries stay in place, unreclaimed discards are spliced back, and node isolated accounting is corrected for both file and anonymous families to cover lazyfree rotation.

Frozen extraction normalizes per order free piles by applying post allocation processing to every block, leaving order zero untouched, and expanding higher orders into individual frames appended in address order to the order zero pile.

Contiguous reservation ignores placement hints, accepts only io plus filesystem plus reclaim plus a small action set, rejects anything else as invalid, and derives an internal compaction mask from the reclaim plus retry plus warn bits augmented with movable and retry mayfail behavior.

A candidate extent is accepted only when every frame maps to an online page in the expected zone and none is unmovable and huge pages are either skipped on the fast pass or accepted only when smaller than the whole request and below the maximum folio order, advancing by a variable step supplied by the unmovable probe. Separately the last frame of the candidate must still lie inside the zone.

Adding a block to the free lists also credits zone free accounting for the whole block size, while splitting a higher block toward a wanted frame walks downward and keeps the half containing the target and returns the other half to the free lists with its order recorded unless guarded.

A page extension entry is located by taking the frame number relative to the node start rounded down to the maximum block size and scaling by the runtime extension size from the node base. The lookup tolerates a missing base during early boot or hotplug by returning null.

Early extension handling defaults differ by build configuration, with a boot option that can force it on, while acceptance of new memory defaults to lazy with a boot option selecting lazy or eager and rejecting other values.

Candidate scanning holds the zone lock with interrupts saved but releases it across the potentially sleeping reservation attempt and reacquires it afterwards, while poison extraction and return hold the same lock for their entire critical section through a scoped guard.
Once pageblocks are isolated, extraction of the outer isolated extent needs no zone lock because isolated pages cannot be removed concurrently.

Allocation context carries zonelist and nodemask and preferred_zoneref and migratetype and highest_zoneidx and spread_dirty_pages and alloc_flags. The highest index both protects lower zones through reserves and bounds reclaim and compaction targets.

Fallback outcome distinguishes FALLBACK_FOUND and FALLBACK_EMPTY and FALLBACK_NOCLAIM. The first means a usable migration type was located, the second means the requested order has nothing usable, and the third means claiming the whole block would be unwise despite permission.

Reservation moves from validation through isolation and cache draining and occupant migration with busy tolerance and huge page release and outer boundary discovery and isolation verification and freelist extraction and either order zero splitting with head tail release or single compound preparation, ending with unconditional isolation release.

Search iterates zones and aligned offsets inside each zone, validating and attempting reservation per candidate, then optionally repeats the whole walk allowing huge page targets when the first walk skipped any, finally reporting success or null.
Reclamation moves from selection of clean candidates through guarded shrinking to splicing of survivors and correction of isolated accounting.
Exact interval entry rejects compound use at the outer layer, ensuring only the frozen core handles compound preparation, and guarantees referenced pages on success.
Counted entry provides the same compound rejection and reference guarantee for zonelist search results.

Buddy membership probing reads orders without locking and is therefore advisory. Extension lookup requires read side protection and callers must handle null. Compound reservations require exact alignment and power of two length and mis sized requests fail. Hardware poison return depends on the reference count reaching zero.

Failure diagnostics that dump the stack and each pending page occur only when dynamic debugging for relocation problems is enabled and warnings are not suppressed, while busy migration failures fall through to an isolation test that reports the culprit through tracing.
ALLOC_DEFAULT is zero. ALLOC_WMARK_MIN and ALLOC_WMARK_LOW and ALLOC_WMARK_HIGH alias generic watermark levels. ALLOC_NO_WATERMARKS is four. ALLOC_WMARK_MASK is bypass minus one.

ALLOC_OOM has two build variants with value eight or aliasing the no watermark bypass. ALLOC_NON_BLOCK is sixteen and ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE is thirty two and ALLOC_CPUSET is sixty four and ALLOC_CMA is one hundred twenty eight.

ALLOC_NOFRAGMENT has two build variants with value two hundred fifty six or zero. ALLOC_HIGHATOMIC is five hundred twelve and ALLOC_NOLOCK is one thousand twenty four and ALLOC_KSWAPD is two thousand forty eight and ALLOC_NO_CODETAG is four thousand ninety six. ALLOC_RESERVES unions ALLOC_NON_BLOCK and ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE and ALLOC_HIGHATOMIC and ALLOC_OOM.
GFP_MOVABLE_MASK joins reclaimable with movable and GFP_MOVABLE_SHIFT is three. PAGE_EXT_INVALID is one. The allocation header defines a presence guard macro.

Extension operations table is built at init time from optionally compiled features for ownership and idle tracking on thirty two bit builds and allocation profiling and table checking and iommu debugging, with idle support unconditionally required when present and sharing flags. Runtime extension size and total usage counters start as plain globals.
